semantics.gap_rule: Every failed closure check produces an explicit machine-readable gap.
semantics.no_guess_rule: Validator never repairs missing semantics by guessing.
semantics.outsider_rule: Outsiders remain explicit findings rather than disappearing from closure reports.
semantics.lock_rule: Locked status requires all mandatory closure checks to pass or an explicitly permitted exception contract.
semantics.clean_tree_rule: A clean replacement tree is validated as a whole before replacing the previous canonical tree.

invariants.rule: A generic reader can resolve canonical identity, Topic context, references and semantic ownership without filesystem or prose heuristics.

replacement tree accepted without whole-tree validation
